# uzc_network_acl_rule (Resource)

Manages a rule in a network ACL list of a UzCloud VPC (see `uzc_network_acl_list`). Rules are evaluated by `number`, lowest first. The resource ID is "{vpc}/{acl_list_id}/{rule_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_network_acl_rule" "ssh" {
  vpc          = uzc_vpc.example.slug
  acl_list_id  = uzc_network_acl_list.app.acl_id
  number       = 10
  protocol     = "tcp"
  start_port   = 22
  cidr_list    = "203.0.113.0/24"
  action       = "allow"
  traffic_type = "ingress"
  description  = "SSH from the office"
}

resource "uzc_network_acl_rule" "ping" {
  vpc          = uzc_vpc.example.slug
  acl_list_id  = uzc_network_acl_list.app.acl_id
  number       = 20
  protocol     = "icmp"
  icmp_type    = -1
  icmp_code    = -1
  cidr_list    = "0.0.0.0/0"
  action       = "allow"
  traffic_type = "ingress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acl_list_id` (String) ID of the list (`acl_id` of `uzc_network_acl_list`).
- `action` (String) "allow" or "deny".
- `cidr_list` (String) CIDR block the rule applies to, e.g. "0.0.0.0/0".
- `number` (Number) Position of the rule in the list; unique within the list.
- `protocol` (String) One of "tcp", "udp", "icmp", "all", or "protocol_number" (with `protocol_number`).
- `traffic_type` (String) "ingress" or "egress".
- `vpc` (String) Slug of the uzc_vpc the list belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `end_port` (Number) Last port, for "tcp" and "udp". Defaults to `start_port`.
- `icmp_code` (Number) ICMP code for "icmp"; -1 for any.
- `icmp_type` (Number) ICMP type for "icmp"; -1 for any.
- `protocol_number` (Number) IP protocol number, used when `protocol` is "protocol_number".
- `start_port` (Number) First port, for "tcp" and "udp".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{vpc}/{acl_list_id}/{rule_id}". Used for import.
- `rule_id` (String) Server-assigned rule id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_network_acl_rule.ssh <vpc-slug>/<acl-list-id>/<rule-id>
```
